body_html:
The Zim high-back synchro-tilter pairs a sculpted wrap-around mesh back with weight-sensing tilt that adjusts itself to whoever sits down — making it a smart choice for shared workstations, touchdown spaces, and meeting rooms where one chair serves many people. Built by Global Furniture Group under the Offices To Go line, it delivers breathable all-day support without a fussy controls learning curve. This ergonomic office chair is Made in Canada and OECM-eligible, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender.

Features

  • Wrap-around mesh back for breathability and full-day comfort
  • Synchro-tilt mechanism with weight-sensing tension that auto-adjusts to the user
  • Multi-position tilt-lock to set your preferred recline
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment (18"–22.5")
  • Seat-depth adjustment to fit a range of body types
  • Height-adjustable T-arms with soft urethane armcaps
  • Dual-wheel carpet casters and a durable five-star base

Specifications

Overall dimensions 26"W x 24.5"D x 43"H with a 18"–22.5" seat-height range and a 300 lb rating. Tested to meet or exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards and certified GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold for low chemical emissions.
